# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 3 tokens; Text — 2 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 2 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 14 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 6 tokens; Radius — 4 tokens; Shadow — 1 token.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--surface, #f5f8fc);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--surface, #07152a);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #f5f8fc;
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--surface` | #f5f8fc | #07152a | Fondo de página del portal y del panel. |
| `--surface-raised` | #ffffff | #0e2340 | Tarjetas, tablas, modales y formularios sobre surface. |
| `--surface-sunken` | #edf1f6 | #16304f | Campos de texto, filas alternas, fondo del estado Ingresado. |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--ink, #09213d);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--ink, #eaf1fa);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #09213d;
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--ink` | #09213d | #eaf1fa | Texto principal sobre surface, surface-raised y surface-sunken (≥14:1 en ambos temas). |
| `--ink-muted` | #4b5d75 | #9db0c8 | Texto secundario, etiquetas y metadatos sobre surface, surface-raised y surface-sunken (≥5.9:1). |

## Color · Fills and status backgrounds

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */

/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--on-blue, #04101f);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #ffffff;
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--on-blue` | #ffffff | #04101f | Texto e íconos sobre un relleno blue-strong (5.9:1 claro, 6.8:1 oscuro). |
| `--on-green` | #ffffff | #04101f | Texto sobre relleno green (5.4:1 claro, 10:1 oscuro). |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--line, #d6dfea);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--line, #1f3656);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #d6dfea;
```

| `--blue` | #0074f9 | #0074f9 | Azul eléctrico de marca: mitad 'cliente' del logo, ilustraciones, íconos y rellenos grandes. Como texto solo a 24px o más (4.3:1 sobre blanco). |
| `--blue-strong` | #005fd1 | #4d9bff | Enlaces, botón primario, anillo de foco y texto del estado En revisión (≥5.1:1 sobre surface y blue-soft). |
| `--blue-soft` | #e5f0ff | #0d2a52 | Fondo del estado En revisión, filas seleccionadas, avisos informativos. |
| `--spark` | #ff8a1f | #ff8a1f | Acento chispa: destacados puntuales (ofertas en el catálogo, punto de notificación). Nunca como texto ni como color de botón. |
| `--amber` | #8f4a00 | #ffb366 | Texto e ícono del estado Esperando repuesto y alertas de stock bajo, sobre amber-soft (≥6:1). |
| `--amber-soft` | #fff0de | #3a2408 | Fondo del estado Esperando repuesto y de alertas de stock bajo. |
| `--teal` | #00737a | #4fd1d9 | Texto e ícono del estado En reparación, sobre teal-soft (≥4.9:1). |
| `--teal-soft` | #ddf5f5 | #08333a | Fondo del estado En reparación. |
| `--green` | #1c7a3e | #5fd48a | Texto del estado Reparado sobre green-soft; relleno sólido del estado Listo para entrega con on-green. |
| `--green-soft` | #e2f5e8 | #0d3320 | Fondo del estado Reparado y de mensajes de éxito. |
| `--danger` | #ba0000 | #ff7a7a | Errores, garantía vencida, acciones destructivas; texto sobre danger-soft (≥4.7:1). |
| `--danger-soft` | #fde7e7 | #3d0f12 | Fondo de errores y alertas críticas. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 700 48px/52px "Sora", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-display);
font-family: var(--font-display);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display` | `.display`, `--text-display` | 48px / 52px | 700 | `display` |  |
| `h1` | `.h1`, `--text-h1` | 32px / 38px | 700 | `display` |  |
| `h2` | `.h2`, `--text-h2` | 24px / 30px | 600 | `display` |  |
| `h3` | `.h3`, `--text-h3` | 18px / 24px | 600 | `display` |  |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 15px / 22px | 400 | `sans` |  |
| `body-strong` | `.body-strong`, `--text-body-strong` | 15px / 22px | 600 | `sans` |  |
| `small` | `.small`, `--text-small` | 13px / 18px | 400 | `sans` |  |
| `label` | `.label`, `--text-label` | 12px / 16px | 600 | `sans` |  |
| `codigo` | `.codigo`, `--text-codigo` | 13px / 18px | 500 | `mono` |  |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `display` | `--font-display` | `"Sora", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif` |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `"Inter", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif` |
| `mono` | `--font-mono` | `"JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (6)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Separación ícono–texto. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Relleno de etiquetas de estado; espacio entre controles pequeños. |
| `--space-3` | 12px | Espacio entre botones y entre campos de un formulario. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Relleno de tarjetas y celdas de tabla. |
| `--space-6` | 24px | Separación entre bloques de una página; márgenes del portal. |
| `--space-8` | 32px | Separación entre secciones. |
